## Full Catalog of Services
1. [Accounting & Bookkeeping Services](https://www.sajidtaxconsultant.online/#services): Daily computerized ledger posting, bank reconciliations, monthly P&L and balance sheets on Tally/Zoho/QuickBooks.
2. [Tax Audit under Section 44AB](https://www.sajidtaxconsultant.online/#services): Statutory audits for businesses exceeding turnover thresholds, Form 3CA/3CB/3CD filing with the Income Tax Department.
3. [Income Tax Return (ITR) Filing](https://www.sajidtaxconsultant.online/#services): ITR-1, ITR-2, ITR-3, ITR-4 (Presumptive 44AD/44ADA) for salaried, business owners, professionals, freelancers, and corporations. Maximum legal tax deduction claiming under old and new tax regimes.
4. [GST Registration & Monthly GSTR Filing](https://www.sajidtaxconsultant.online/#services): New GSTIN registration, GSTR-1, GSTR-3B monthly/quarterly filings, GSTR-9 annual return, ITC reconciliation, and GST notice replies.
5. [Pvt Ltd & LLP Company Incorporation](https://www.sajidtaxconsultant.online/#services): Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA) SPICe+ filing, Director Identification Number (DIN), Digital Signature Certificate (DSC), MOA & AOA drafting, and PAN/TAN allotment.
6. [Udyam MSME Registration](https://www.sajidtaxconsultant.online/#services): Official Government of India MSME certificate for subsidies, priority sector lending, and collateral-free loan eligibility.
7. [Mumbai Gumasta License (Shop & Establishment)](https://www.sajidtaxconsultant.online/#services): Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) intimation and registration for commercial establishments and offices in Mumbai.
8. [TDS & TCS Returns Compliance](https://www.sajidtaxconsultant.online/#services): Quarterly Form 24Q (Salary), 26Q (Non-Salary), 27Q (NRI) preparation, challan payments, and Form 16/16A generation.
9. [EPFO PF Registration](https://www.sajidtaxconsultant.online/#services): Employer PF establishment code, employee UAN generation, monthly ECR filing, and compliance audits.
10. [PF Withdrawal & Rejection Fixes](https://www.sajidtaxconsultant.online/#services): Online Form 19, 10C, 31 claims, correction of father's name, Date of Exit resolution, and clearing EPFO rejection queries.
